article.headline: Charlotte faces Los Angeles, looks to stop road losing streak
article.description: Charlotte Hornets (4-8, 11th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Los Angeles Clippers (2-8, 13th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Charlotte faces Los Angeles, looks to stop road losing streak
article.linkText: Charlotte faces Los Angeles, looks to stop road losing streak
article.story: Charlotte Hornets (4-8, 11th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Los Angeles Clippers (2-8, 13th in the Western Conference) Inglewood, California; Sunday, 4:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Charlotte will try to stop its four-game road losing streak when the Hornets visit Los Angeles. Los Angeles finished 42-40 overall last season while going 23-18 at home. The Clippers averaged 23.7 assists per game on 40.5 made field goals last season. Charlotte went 44-38 overall, 26-26 in Eastern Conference play and 23-18 on the road a season ago. The Hornets averaged 15.6 points off of turnovers, 17.9 second-chance points and 36.2 bench points last season. INJURIES: Clippers: Yanic Konan Niederhauser: out (lisfranc), Jordan Miller: out (shoulder), Brandon Ingram: out (heel), Bradley Beal: out (knee). Hornets: Kon Knueppel: day to day (leg), Dennis Schroder: day to day (soreness), Brandon Miller: day to day (groin). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
